quest.title: Moonfinger
quest.description: Childe introduced you to Zhongli, a consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. You agree to help Zhongli organize the Rite of Parting in the hope of seeing the Geo Archon again.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Primogem x30, Mora x22850, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Jade Mystery, my good friends! Would you like to try your luck betting on jade? This could be your lucky day.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: It's cheap and it's fun, and who knows, you just might strike it rich!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Betting? No, no, we're here for... um, what was it again?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Noctilucous Jade, of radiant grade at the very least.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Radiant grade Noctilucous Jade? I see, you're not a tourist. My apologies. I have some here for your perusal...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: (Fade to black. Shitou fetches goods.)

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: What do you think? The Jade Mystery is an old name in the jade business. Just look at that wonderful quality! Rex Lapis doesn't often bless us with such finery. Go on, pick whichever one you like!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These three pieces really do look pretty, not like the ones you usually dig up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how do we pick? Should we just grab one and go?

choices.text: A man who makes his living off betting on stones can't be trusted so lightly.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Very good. It seems you have learned some tricks of the trade.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you think, Mr. Zhongli? How should we pick from these pieces of Noctilucous Jade?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Oh? You want me to decide? That is fine as well.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If it were me, the answer would be simple.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh? And that would be...?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I'll take them all, boss.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Oh, you act with such panache, good sir! I always knew you were not a man of ordinary caliber!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait! Wait! Boss, that one didn't count! We need to discuss it again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Fade to black while Zhongli, protagonist, and Paimon step to one side to talk amongst themselves)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! If we only need one for the ritual, aren't we wasting three times the Mora if we buy them all!?

choices.text: That's true.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Oh, Mora. Hmm...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: It is as you say. I suppose I overlooked this particular aspect of the transaction.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? How do you not think about Mora when buying things!?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If one must always consider Mora before acting, then in all things one is bound by Mora.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh... What?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: All Mora is currency, but not all currency is Mora.

choices.text: He's talking about economics.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is this how the rich live?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, he knows a lot about big money, but not a lot about big savings.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: No need to waver. Even when I am constrained by Mora, I have ways of working around my limitations.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Evaluating the quality of Noctilucous Jade is indeed very tricky. As crude ore, there is little difference in texture, lustrousness, and internal pattern between good and bad Jade.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Only after the item made using Noctilucous Jade has taken shape, will you be able to see whether it is up to par or not.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If you return to those crafty merchants to quibble, they will counter by saying that your crafting bench is to blame, or that your heat control was poor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! To think it's that easy to get cheated...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: But there is a way to truly evaluate this jade, and a true insider would know it.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: "A fool sees the pointer and misses the moon."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What does that mean?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: If you point at the moon with your finger, a wise man knows that you are pointing at the moon, while a fool will only see the finger.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The patterns, the facade, these are all the "finger." Noctilucous Jade is a mystical stone used to light up the darkness, and so its brightness is the important thing — it is the "moon."

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Noctilucous Jade of excellent quality would have superior Pyro affinity. In other words, the bluer and brighter the luster of the ore under high temperature, the higher its quality.

choices.text: I didn't realize you were such an expert...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I have imparted the priceless secrets of the jade trade to you. Now all that's left is to put it into practice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Priceless, huh... Paimon's just sad that we might never be able to use it again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Fade to black while Zhongli, protagonist and Paimon return to Shitou's store)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're back to buy some rocks, boss. But can you let us burn them first?

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: B—Burn them? You can't do that, my friends! If you were to do so, what would I have to sell?

choices.text: Then, can we get some small samples?

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: That... Well, fine. As you wish, then.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: How about this? I can take a small sample of all three. I'll take a bit of a loss — we'll count it as a friendly gesture.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Don't worry, I know the rules. As long as we can prove that it is good jade, you will not take a loss.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: (Fade to black. Shitou obtains samples.)

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Alright. Take these as samples. I've carved them off with a knife and tagged them to boot.

choices.text: These samples...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Aren't these too thin?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even paper's thicker. No, even a bug's wings are thicker! These are almost see-through!

choices.text: How stingy...

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Stingy? I've already been very generous. Any more, and you may as well have my neck!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But wouldn't something this thin go poof if we held it to the fire?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: It can't be helped. Trying to deprive a merchant of his profits would be like forcing a ravenous wolf to vomit up the food in its stomach. Nonetheless, under the right conditions, these thin slices will serve.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What sort of conditions?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: While we add the high temperatures using Pyro, we can use Hydro to reinforce it from within. This way, the samples will not disintegrate immediately.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Oh? Oh, sir, to think you were this learned... Thank you for your understanding!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Strictly speaking, asking for samples when we have not yet agreed to purchase the goods is unfair. Trade in Liyue must be based upon fairness.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, guess we just need to find a place to try this out...

choices.text: I remember this spot in the Dadaupa Gorge...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Paimon remembers! We once saw this <color=#00E1FFFF>biiiiig pot</color> down at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>, in the camp of the hilichurls from the Meaty Tribe! It's real sturdy, and should be able to take the elemental reactions!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, now, let's pack those samples up and make a move!

choices.text: How about the kitchen at Xiangling's place...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean at Wanmin Restaurant? As long as we do it when she's not in...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: That would not do. It is a place where people come and go. They would be endangered if the elemental reaction were to get out of control... We cannot take such a risk.

choices.text: This is impressive handiwork.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Hahaha. You flatter me, but I have to be gentle with these rocks. They are my pride and joy!

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: If I'd taken off even a bit more, it would have killed me.

choices.text: So thin...
Then I'm not buying any.

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: Not buying...? Ah, come, come now, my good friends... we can still discuss this. Negotiation is key to trade, wouldn't you say?

choices.text: Is this normal life for a high-class gentleman?
Sounds like he's loaded.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So loaded that he doesn't even bother hunting for a bargain.

choices.text: Actually, it's two times more Mora.
What do you think, Mr. Zhongli?

talks.objective: Look for the Meaty tribe's giant cooking pot

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the pot! It looks like the hilichurls are still using it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's still soup in here. These hilichurls sure have big appetites!

choices.text: Well, it's our lab now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This soup looks like it could be used as our Hydro elemental protection. Let's fire it up and begin our experiment!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Animation: Carefully place or throw samples into cooking pot)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're ready to go! Paimon will help remember which one of the three is which!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Use <color=#00E1FFFF>Pyro</color> to keep making the pot hotter, until we get the results we need.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mr. Zhongli said that the <color=#00E1FFFF>shinier and bluer</color> the ore gets, the better it is, so pay close attention!

choices.text: Shame to let it go to waste...

talks.objective: Use Pyro to heat the pot
Use Pyro to heat the pot
Use Pyro to heat the pot

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! That light came from the first Noctilucous Jade!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I would like the first Noctilucous Jade.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I would like the second Noctilucous Jade.

talks.objective: Return to Liyue Harbor and find Shitou

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I would like the third Noctilucous Jade.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly, that's the one Paimon remembers too!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: No problem. If you have your eye on this one, you can have it.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Then we'll take a box of the third type of jade.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Done!

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: All the same... Pardon me for asking, but I'm curious. Whatever do you need this much top-quality Noctilucous Jade for?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm. I suppose it would not hurt to tell you. We need them to make implements for the Rite of Parting.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Parting...!? Oh dear... I'd heard the rumors but hadn't given much thought to them. This... this means that Rex Lapis really is...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: ...It's hard to believe. Even though the Jade Mystery has been in decline, we have always been under his protection.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: It is said that when our Lord lost his way while going incognito in the city two hundred years ago, it was a spoon from The Jade Mystery that he had used to sample the local delights.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Alas, alas, all things must pass... Well, if this is to be used to say farewell to Rex Lapis, then I shall sell this to you at half the price.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure? You didn't wanna even give us an inch before...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: If not for our Lord's protection, this city wouldn't exist as it does now. No proprietor could earn money off such a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww... I'm sure Rex Lapis will feel your sentiment, boss.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: In the safe hands of the Liyue Qixing and good, honest merchants such as yourself, I, for one, believe that Liyue will continue to prosper as it always has done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So let's not get ourselves down just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Alright... thank you, my friends. Hah, what's with me, getting all sentimental like this? I'll practically be giving away all my fortune at this rate.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Now that we've made our choice, let's take this Noctilucous Jade back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, wait a minute! He said it was half price, not that we could leave without paying!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh, right, I'm sorry. I must have forgotten to do that too. Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: ...As I thought, I didn't bring any.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Any what?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Mora. My apologies, another oversight on my part.

choices.text: What a strange take on the value of money...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That won't do, this isn't some small sum... Oh wait, didn't Childe give us some advance funds earlier?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I have them on me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a relief. Have a look, boss, is it enough?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Animation: Handing Mora to Shitou)

response.speaker: Shitou
response.text: It's fine, just enough for half price... though to be honest, it'd be alright even if the sum wasn't quite enough.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Well, it's settled, then. Let's take this jade to Yujing Terrace. That's where we plan to hold the Rite...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look at you, bossing everyone around! You didn't cough up a single Mora!

choices.text: Please remember to bring money next time.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I will do my best. You have my thanks.

choices.text: Guess we need to find Childe for more funding.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Mm, it seems that we must. I will keep that in mind. Thanks, both of you.

choices.text: A local of Liyue who doesn't have money on their mind...

talks.objective: Put the Noctilucous Jade in place

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: Ah... Rex Lapis... Rex Lapis...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: We can leave the jade here. I have already called for a jewelsmith to shape them into the implements that we will need.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I have yet to go and see Childe. So as for the jewelsmith's remuneration...

choices.text: We'll pay the jewelsmith when he arrives.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess we can't do anything else. Also, is this where we're doing the Rite of Parting?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Yes. I have already rented this location, and have begun making preparations for the rite.

choices.text: The Rite of Descension took place here, too.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: That's right. The Liyue Qixing have acquiesced to using the same location.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But when something this big happened here... should suspects like us really be at the crime scene? We might get caught by the Millelith.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Although with that said, since we got back from Jueyun Karst, none of those pesky Millelith soldiers have come chasing after us. Wonder what that's about...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Also, the, uh, Rex Lapis' vessel...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Traditionally, we call it the Exuvia.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, right. That's what it was called! You seem to know everything, Mr. Zhongli. Um, so, was this Exuvia hidden away by the Qixing? I mean, we haven't even figured out who the murderer is...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: One must think that they already have someone in mind. Or perhaps they already know. Surely they must have found all the evidence that there is to find here.

choices.text: It still feels very odd.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: These things are for the authorities in Yujing Terrace to consider. Trying to help would probably only add to their troubles.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Before the Rite is conducted, the Exuvia will be kept temporarily in the Golden House.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Golden House?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The only mint in Liyue... which is to say the only mint in Teyvat. All the Mora that flows throughout the world is minted there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, Paimon wasn't thinking about anything bad. Paimon thinks it suits Morax.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But why do you know this, Mr. Zhongli?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Since the Rite of Parting has the approval of the Qixing, it is a semi-official event. As such, there is already some limited information available.

choices.text: The Qixing provide the location, and Childe the funds...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Perhaps each has their motives... but this is the capital of commerce. A little exploitation once in a while is not unacceptable.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: In Liyue, where the God of Contracts reigns, only contracts may not be betrayed. I for one have no issue with little maneuvers outside their remit.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Well then, we should go and prepare the <color=#00E1FFFF>perfumes</color> used in the Rite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Perfumes? Where'll we get those? Do we buy them?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: No, perfumes used to honor the gods must be freshly decocted. The quality of the <color=#00E1FFFF>Silk Flowers</color> we require is also special.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Silk Flower petals contain a fibrous material of good quality, often used in brocade-making. Its scent, however, is most elegant, and is especially suited for solemn events like giving offerings to gods and adepti.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's time for Zhongli's lectures on high society again...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: We shall not speak of the details right now. Follow me, we shall go to the merchants to purchase our ingredients.

choices.text: They must have some ulterior motive...
Seems a bit too easy-going...
So we're just using the scene of the crime to...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The Liyue Qixing have agreed to this arrangement.

choices.text: Fingers crossed Childe will reimburse us...

dialogues.speaker: Shitou
dialogues.text: You're back, my friends! I've kept the goods for you. Which of them would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? No, it wasn't that one, Paimon remembers that it wasn't very bright.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Think a bit harder...
